item.title: Version 1.3.1
item.description:
Select a bunch of notes at once. Browse Notes now has a Select mode — tap the checkmark next to the sort button, or just Cmd-click any note. Tick the ones you want, then move them all to a folder (new folders included) or send them to the Trash in one go. Select All, Unselect All, and Done sit right there in the toolbar, and Esc backs you out.

Settings got a proper going-over. Global shortcuts now show as real keycaps — click one to record and it lights up the modifiers as you hold them, exactly like macOS System Settings, and Reset to Defaults puts them back if you change your mind. The Behavior switches are now sorted into Panel, Browse Notes, and System groups, each with an icon and a plain-English caption, and the Notes Directory row shows your folder, how many notes are in it, and a button to reveal it in Finder.

Smoother typing in big notes. The editor used to re-scan the whole document for code fences on every keystroke and scroll. Now it only looks at what's on screen, so long or code-heavy notes stay responsive.

No more phantom notes. When iCloud, Obsidian, or git touched your files, Flotnote could pile up duplicate or empty ghost notes and flicker the list. It now folds those bursts into a single refresh, only redraws when something actually changed, and drops the empty notes you've navigated away from — just like Apple Notes.

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
• New: **Action panel** (`Cmd+K` or the bolt button in the titlebar) — a searchable command palette with every Flotnote action: New/Duplicate/Browse/Find, Move to Folder, Pin, Show in Finder, Delete; Copy Note As Markdown/HTML/Plain Text (`Cmd+Shift+C`); Export to file or Share to other apps (`Cmd+Shift+E`); a Format sub-panel (`Cmd+Shift+,`) incl. new Code Block; Move Line Up/Down (`Ctrl+Cmd+↑/↓`); Reset Window Size (`Cmd+Shift+0`); Hide/Show Format Bar (`Opt+Cmd+,`); editor zoom (`Cmd+=` / `Cmd+-` / `Cmd+0`); and Show/Hide While Screen Sharing (`Cmd+Shift+H`). Copy/save show a success toast, Delete asks for confirmation, and shortcut badges reflect your configured Settings shortcuts. The Settings gear moved out of the titlebar into the Action panel (`Cmd+,` still works)
  • Much faster note search: results are now computed once per keystroke instead of dozens of times per render, sorting no longer happens while typing, and extending a query only re-scans the previous results — typing in Browse Notes stays smooth with large libraries

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
• Fixed right-click menus (and their submenus) closing when the cursor moved outside the Flotnote window — the window's hover tracking no longer updates while a menu is open
  • New: folder picker in the title area — see and change which folder a note lives in; for a brand-new note it chooses where the file is created. Opens with a click or `Cmd+Shift+M`, has a search box to filter folders, and typing a name that doesn't exist offers Create "name" inline
  • New: right-click a note in the switcher → Move to Folder (also Pin, Show in Finder, Move to Trash)
  • New notes (Cmd+N / + button) are now created in the same folder as the currently active note instead of always the root
  • Renaming or moving a note no longer recreates the editor — notes now keep a stable internal identity when their file path changes, fixing focus hiccups after a title commit
  • Fixed rename filename-collision checks running against the root folder for notes inside subfolders
  • Fixed the entire formatting toolbar (Bold, Italic, lists, etc.) permanently stopping working — a stale cursor position cached from a previous note could point outside the current note; every toolbar action then failed silently, and the poisoned cache was never cleared until the app restarted. The cache is now invalidated on note switch and validated before use
  • Fixed tables sometimes not rendering when a note is first opened (only fixed by toggling Source Mode and back) — the table widget now rebuilds when background parsing finishes
  • Typing a single `-` under a line of text no longer turns it into a heading — setext H2 now requires at least `--`, so starting a bullet point doesn't restyle the text above. Note: `---` typed directly under text now renders as a divider (horizontal rule) instead of a heading
  • Fixed list lines jumping left when the cursor enters them — the active line now keeps the same hanging indent as its rendered version, and the raw `-`/`1.` marker sits in the same spot as the rendered bullet. This also makes multi-line selection highlights over lists align evenly

item.title: Version 1.1.5
item.description: • Fixed typing the letter "a" unexpectedly opening a file picker (or toggling the window) after a keyboard shortcut had been cleared in Settings — a cleared shortcut is no longer mistaken for the "a" key

item.title: Version 1.1.4
item.description: • Fixed new notes sometimes refusing keyboard input — after a character or two, typing would stop with a beep and focus could jump to the desktop/Finder. New notes now reliably keep keyboard focus in the title and editor.

item.title: Version 1.1.3
item.description:
• Fixed notes briefly showing as empty (or jumping to a random note) while iCloud is still syncing — the current note now stays open and a "Syncing from iCloud…" loading screen is shown until downloads finish
  • Fixed underscores inside words being treated as italic (e.g. `test_one_two` rendered as `testonetwo`) — intraword underscores are now kept literal, matching standard Markdown

item.title: Version 1.1.2
